panels.title: Spend

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, sum(cost_usd) AS spend FROM otel.api_requests WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: What these requests would cost at API prices.

panels.title: Prompts

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, count() AS prompts FROM otel.prompts WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Messages that started a turn: yours, plus task notifications and automated reruns.

panels.title: Spend per prompt

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(cost_usd) / uniqExact(prompt_id) AS spend_per_prompt FROM otel.api_requests WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.description: Average spend behind one prompt, counting its subagents and compactions.

panels.title: Average context

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(context_tokens) AS average_context FROM otel.api_requests WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.description: Tokens sent with the average request. Every request resends the whole conversation.

panels.title: Cache hit rate

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(cache_read_tokens) / sum(context_tokens) AS cache_hit_rate FROM otel.api_requests WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.description: Share of context tokens read from cache, which costs a small fraction of uncached input.

panels.title: Spent on compaction

targets.rawSql: SELECT sumIf(cost_usd, activity = 'Compaction') / sum(cost_usd) AS compaction_share FROM otel.api_requests WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.description: Share of spend on summarizing a full conversation to free up context.

panels.title: Main conversation spend by context size

targets.rawSql:
WITH (
  SELECT coalesce(minIfOrNull(pre_tokens, in_range), minOrNull(pre_tokens))
  FROM (
    SELECT toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['pre_tokens']) AS pre_tokens, ($__timeFilter(Timestamp)) AS in_range
    FROM otel.otel_logs
    WHERE LogAttributes['event.name'] = 'compaction' AND LogAttributes['trigger'] = 'auto'
  )
) AS compacts_at
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(ts) AS time,
  multiIf(
    compacts_at IS NULL, 'No auto-compaction recorded',
    context_tokens < compacts_at, 'Within auto-compaction',
    'Past auto-compaction'
  ) AS band,
  sum(cost_usd) AS spend
FROM otel.api_requests
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND activity = 'Main conversation'
GROUP BY time, band
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Every request resends the whole conversation, so a long context makes each one dearer. The split is the smallest context at which an automatic compaction fired in the range. Red is spend on requests sent above it: sessions started before auto-compaction was on, conversations opened or replayed above it, or a turn that outgrew it before compacting.

panels.title: Main conversation round trips

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(started) AS time,
  avg(requests) AS "Requests per prompt",
  sum(spend) / sum(requests) AS "Cost per request"
FROM (
  SELECT prompt_id, min(ts) AS started, count() AS requests, sum(cost_usd) AS spend
  FROM otel.api_requests
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND activity = 'Main conversation'
  GROUP BY prompt_id
)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.description: How many requests one prompt takes, and what each costs. Every tool call ends a request and the next one resends the context, so batching independent calls lowers the first line, and compaction and cheaper models lower the second. Each prompt counts at the time of its first request.

panels.title: Cache writes by cause

targets.rawSql:
SELECT cause, sum(cache_write_cost) AS spend
FROM (
  SELECT
    ts,
    cache_write_cost,
    multiIf(
      n = 1 AND context_tokens > 50000, 'Opened on a long conversation',
      n = 1, 'Session start',
      cache_read_tokens >= 0.5 * prev_context, 'New content',
      model != prev_model, 'Model switch',
      context_tokens < 0.7 * prev_context, 'After compaction',
      gap_seconds > 3600, 'Resumed after an hour idle',
      gap_seconds > 300, 'Resumed after 5 to 60 minutes idle',
      'Cache miss mid-session'
    ) AS cause
  FROM (
    SELECT
      ts,
      cache_write_cost,
      cache_read_tokens,
      context_tokens,
      model,
      lagInFrame(model, 1, '') OVER w AS prev_model,
      lagInFrame(context_tokens, 1, 0) OVER w AS prev_context,
      dateDiff('second', lagInFrame(ts, 1, ts) OVER w, ts) AS gap_seconds,
      row_number() OVER w AS n
    FROM otel.api_requests
    WHERE ts >= $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND ts <= $__toTime AND activity = 'Main conversation'
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
  )
)
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY cause
ORDER BY spend DESC

panels.description: Main conversation spend on writing the prompt cache. New content is written once and cannot be avoided. The rest is the conversation being written again: a new session, a session opened on a long conversation, a model switch, a compaction, a pause, or a miss.

panels.title: Main conversation spend by what started the turn

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p.origin AS started_by, sum(r.cost_usd) AS spend
FROM otel.api_requests AS r
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT prompt_id, any(origin) AS origin
  FROM otel.prompts
  WHERE ts >= $__fromTime - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND ts <= $__toTime
  GROUP BY prompt_id
) AS p ON r.prompt_id = p.prompt_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts) AND r.activity = 'Main conversation'
GROUP BY started_by
ORDER BY spend DESC

panels.description: Main conversation spend grouped by the slash command or message that started the turn. Subagents are left out, since a background subagent's requests carry whichever prompt is current when they run, often a later task notification.

panels.title: Main conversation spend by model

targets.rawSql:
SELECT model_name, sum(cost_usd) AS spend
FROM otel.api_requests
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND activity = 'Main conversation'
GROUP BY model_name
ORDER BY spend DESC

panels.description: Which model the main conversation ran on. Fable 5.1 charges two and a half times Opus 5.5 for input, output and cache writes, so a session left on Fable for routine work pays more for the same tokens.

panels.title: Subagent cost per run

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  concat(s.agent, ' on ', s.model_name) AS agent_model,
  s.spend / c.runs AS per_run
FROM (
  SELECT agent, model, model_name, sum(cost_usd) AS spend
  FROM otel.api_requests
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND agent != ''
  GROUP BY agent, model, model_name
) AS s
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT agent, model, count() AS runs
  FROM otel.subagent_runs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  GROUP BY agent, model
) AS c ON s.agent = c.agent AND s.model = c.model
ORDER BY per_run DESC

panels.description: Spend of each subagent on each model over the range, divided by its finished runs. Runs that straddle the range's edges skew it, so it reads truest over ranges much longer than one run. The same reviewer costs very different amounts depending on the model the review picks.

panels.title: Rule files and skills read into context

targets.rawSql:
SELECT file, sum(result_bytes) AS bytes
FROM (
  SELECT
    concat(input, ' ', parameters) AS src,
    multiIf(
      match(src, '\\.agents/rulebook/'), concat('rulebook/', extract(src, '\\.agents/rulebook/([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+(/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)?)')),
      match(src, '/skills/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+'), concat('skill: ', extract(src, '/skills/([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)')),
      ''
    ) AS file,
    result_bytes
  FROM otel.tool_results
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
)
WHERE file != ''
GROUP BY file
ORDER BY bytes DESC

panels.description: Bytes of rule files and skill files read through tools. Each read stays in the conversation and is resent with every later request until a compaction, so trimming a file saves on every read of it.

panels.title: Spend by activity

targets.rawSql: SELECT activity, sum(cost_usd) AS spend FROM otel.api_requests WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY activity ORDER BY spend DESC

panels.description: Main conversation is your own session. Compaction summarizes a full conversation. Subagents are broken down by name further down.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, activity, sum(cost_usd) AS spend FROM otel.api_requests WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY time, activity ORDER BY time

panels.title: Spend by token type

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  sum(input_cost) AS "Input",
  sum(cache_read_cost) AS "Cache reads",
  sum(cache_write_cost) AS "Cache writes",
  sum(output_cost) AS "Output",
  sum(other_cost) AS "Other"
FROM otel.api_requests WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.description: Input is context sent uncached, charged in full. Cache reads are context reused from cache. Cache writes store new context for the next request. Output is what the model wrote.

panels.title: Spend by context size at the time of the request

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  concat(toString(intDiv(context_tokens, 50000) * 50), '-', toString((intDiv(context_tokens, 50000) + 1) * 50), 'K') AS context_size,
  sum(input_cost) AS "Input",
  sum(cache_read_cost) AS "Cache reads",
  sum(cache_write_cost) AS "Cache writes",
  sum(output_cost) AS "Output",
  sum(other_cost) AS "Other"
FROM otel.api_requests
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY intDiv(context_tokens, 50000) AS bucket, context_size
ORDER BY bucket

panels.description: Longer conversations cost more per request, since every request resends the whole context.

panels.title: Models

targets.rawSql: SELECT model_name, sum(cost_usd) AS spend FROM otel.api_requests WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY model_name ORDER BY spend DESC

panels.description: Spend by model.

panels.title: Repositories

targets.rawSql: SELECT repo, sum(cost_usd) AS spend FROM otel.api_requests WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY repo ORDER BY spend DESC

panels.description: Spend by the git repository the session ran in. The desktop app does not report one.

panels.title: Subagents

targets.rawSql: SELECT agent, sum(cost_usd) AS spend FROM otel.api_requests WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND agent != '' GROUP BY agent ORDER BY spend DESC

panels.description: Spend inside each subagent, launched by a skill or by the main conversation.

panels.title: Skills

targets.rawSql: SELECT skill, sum(cost_usd) AS spend FROM otel.api_requests WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND skill != '' GROUP BY skill ORDER BY spend DESC

panels.description: Spend while a skill was running, including the subagents it launched.

panels.title: Spend by session length

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  multiIf(requests = 1, '1 request', requests <= 10, '2-10', requests <= 50, '11-50', '51+') AS session_length,
  sum(spend) AS "Spend",
  count() AS "Sessions"
FROM (
  SELECT session_id, count() AS requests, sum(cost_usd) AS spend
  FROM otel.api_requests WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  GROUP BY session_id
)
GROUP BY session_length
ORDER BY min(requests)

panels.description: Sessions grouped by how many requests they made. One-request sessions are forks and headless runs that resend a whole conversation once.

panels.title: Context size through the costliest conversations

targets.rawSql:
WITH top_sessions AS (
  SELECT session_id FROM otel.api_requests WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  GROUP BY session_id HAVING countIf(activity = 'Main conversation') >= 5
  ORDER BY sum(cost_usd) DESC LIMIT 6
)
SELECT
  r.ts AS time,
  concat(r.repo, ': ', left(replaceRegexpAll(p.first_prompt, '\\s+', ' '), 50)) AS session,
  r.context_tokens AS context
FROM otel.api_requests AS r
LEFT JOIN otel.session_first_prompts AS p USING session_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND session_id IN top_sessions AND activity = 'Main conversation'
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Each line is one of the six costliest sessions with at least five turns, named by its first prompt. Context grows with every turn and drops after a compaction.

panels.title: Costliest sessions

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  concat(s.session_repo, ': ', left(replaceRegexpAll(if(p.first_prompt = '', '(no prompt recorded)', p.first_prompt), '\\s+', ' '), 60), ' (', left(s.session_id, 8), ')') AS session,
  s.spend
FROM (
  SELECT session_id, any(repo) AS session_repo, sum(cost_usd) AS spend
  FROM otel.api_requests WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 10
) AS s
LEFT JOIN otel.session_first_prompts AS p USING session_id
ORDER BY s.spend DESC

panels.description: Named by the session's first prompt.

panels.title: Costliest prompts

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  left(replaceRegexpAll(if(p.prompt = '', '(no prompt recorded)', p.prompt), '\\s+', ' '), 80) AS prompt,
  c.spend
FROM (
  SELECT prompt_id, sum(cost_usd) AS spend
  FROM otel.api_requests WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  GROUP BY prompt_id ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 10
) AS c
LEFT JOIN (SELECT prompt_id, any(prompt) AS prompt FROM otel.prompts GROUP BY prompt_id) AS p USING prompt_id
ORDER BY c.spend DESC

panels.description: The requests tagged with one prompt: the main reply, its compactions and the subagents it waited for. A background subagent's requests carry whichever prompt is current when they run, often a later task notification. Prompts include task notifications and automated reruns, not only messages you typed.

panels.title: Tool output added to context

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(mcp_server != '', concat('MCP: ', mcp_server), tool) AS tool_name, sum(result_bytes) AS output FROM otel.tool_results WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY output DESC LIMIT 12

panels.description: Bytes each tool returned. Every byte stays in the conversation and is resent with each later request until a compaction.

panels.title: Tool calls

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(mcp_server != '', concat('MCP: ', mcp_server), tool) AS tool_name, count() AS calls FROM otel.tool_results WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY tool_name ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 12

panels.description: How often each tool ran.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  p.ts AS time,
  p.repo AS repo,
  p.prompt AS prompt,
  c.spend AS spend,
  c.requests AS requests
FROM (
  SELECT prompt_id, sum(cost_usd) AS spend, count() AS requests
  FROM otel.api_requests WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
  GROUP BY prompt_id ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT 50
) AS c
JOIN otel.prompts AS p USING prompt_id
ORDER BY c.spend DESC
